# Glypha - AI Crawler Discovery File
# This file helps AI crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) understand our site

## Site
- Name: Glypha
- Type: Premium design freelancing marketplace
- URL: http://localhost:3000
- Description: A curated marketplace of certified designers. Browse the work, pick a defined tier, pay on delivery.

## Capabilities
- Browse certified designers by craft, budget, deadline, and seller level
- View designer portfolios, ratings, and pricing tiers
- Post a job brief and receive scoped proposals
- Manage contracts, messages, and project milestones
- Pay on delivery with escrow protection

## Key Pages
- / - Homepage
- /designers - Designer marketplace
- /designers/[id] - Designer profile page
- /dashboard - User dashboard (authenticated)
- /dashboard/jobs - Job postings
- /dashboard/contracts - Active contracts
- /dashboard/messages - Messaging
- /dashboard/proposals - Proposals
- /dashboard/profile - Profile management
- /dashboard/notifications - Notifications
- /dashboard/settings - Account settings

## Features
- Certified designer verification
- Tiered pricing (Basic, Standard, Premium)
- Escrow payment protection
- Real-time messaging
- Contract management
- Review and rating system
- Portfolio management

## Contact
- Contact point: customer service
